description: Find recurring market reports (commodity and financial outlooks, market reviews, central bank and stability reports) in Signal Lab's Market Reports index, which is separate from the data catalog. Filter by words and by domain, asset class, report type, publisher, cadence and access method; every filter must match. Each row has the next release date (an ISO date from the provider's calendar, or No published calendar / Not yet announced / Calendar not readable), the access level, method and barrier, the provider URL and the Signal Lab page. Returns 20 by default, at most 100. Use get_market_report for every field of one report.

access_method.description: api, rss, direct_pdf, html_page, landing_page, or blocked (blocked to automated reads; see the workaround field)

asset_class.description: One asset class or commodity, for example Copper, Crude oil or Credit

publisher.description: Exact publisher name as it appears in results

query.description: Words that must all appear in the title, publisher, asset classes, domain, report type or coverage

name: search_market_reports
title: Search Market Reports
